name: Baby Metroid
description: The larval Metroid in real LEGO, about 18 cm across, as a tap lamp: press it down and its four fangs bite and its three red nuclei light up; press again and they go dark.

steps.caption: Base disc: bottom layer, left half
Base disc: bottom layer, right half
Base disc: top layer, left half
Base disc: top layer, right half
Guide plate in the middle (the stand's axle slides through its hole) and smooth tiles where the hub's arms will rest
Fang 1: slide its axle through the bearing, fang swung open
Fang 2: slide its axle through the bearing, fang swung open
Fang 3: slide its axle through the bearing, fang swung open
Fang 4: slide its axle through the bearing, fang swung open
Link 1: drop it through the disc and pin it to the lever
Link 2: drop it through the disc and pin it to the lever
Link 3: drop it through the disc and pin it to the lever
Link 4: drop it through the disc and pin it to the lever
Hub on the four links, held by an axle through each
Three posts for the inner body. Then lay the two light leads: push each plug down through the opening in the base, next to the back-left post
Inner membrane: two crossed layers, around the light leads
Push the light up into the centre hole from below
Front nucleus 1: lamp plate, lead down through the opening
Front nucleus 2: lamp plate, lead down through the opening
Back nucleus: a hollow chimney for the light lead
Back nucleus: lamp plate, lead down through the opening
Base plate: bottom layer, left half
Base plate: bottom layer, right half
Base plate: top layer, left half
Base plate: top layer, right half
Battery box, green button and plug facing up
A ring of plates on the walls, to lift the bridge clear of the box
Two crossed layers of plates, with holes for the push rods, the presser and the plug
Belt pins under the bridge, two each side
Set the bridge on the walls, belt pins hanging down
Centre axle: the Metroid's fang hub rides on its top
Push rods, each ending in a Technic brick for the belts, and the presser
Lower the tube's bottom in: push rods and presser go down through the bridge. Hook two belts round each rod's pin and over the two pins beside it
Top plate round the tube (it holds the tube's flange down)
Put the Metroid on its stand
